en.hero.tagline: Building native AI architectures from first principles.
en.identity.p1: I'm an AI Systems Engineer based in Indonesia specializing in native multi-agent architectures, resilient backend web services, and data-layer engineering across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and MySQL.
en.identity.p2: My core strength lies in architectural design, deep technical research, performance profiling, and security auditing. While I collaborate with frontier AI models as research sparring partners and code accelerators, every architectural decision is engineered from first principles and audited manually line by line before shipping.
en.identity.w1Desc: Define system topology, database schema contracts, and failure boundaries.
en.identity.w2Desc: Build lean Python/JS runtimes without heavy black-box orchestration layers.
en.identity.w3Desc: Manual code review, latency profiling, and red-teaming security checks.
en.approach.intro: Modern engineering isn't about typing boilerplate faster—it's about knowing what to build, why a design holds under pressure, and where it breaks.
en.approach.p1Desc: Heavy AI frameworks hide critical execution paths behind fragile abstractions. I build core orchestration loops natively to retain full visibility over state, latency, and token economics.
en.approach.p2Desc: LLMs are probabilistic; production systems cannot be. I isolate probabilistic reasoning from deterministic runtime validation, atomic DB leasing, and strict security boundaries.
en.approach.p3Desc: Every system I ship undergoes manual line-by-line code auditing, architectural stress-testing, and empirical validation for performance bottlenecks and security gaps.
en.astraea.tagline: A zero-framework multi-agent orchestration engine built from scratch.
en.astraea.problemBody: Existing agent frameworks often lock engineers into rigid abstractions, opaque retry loops, and unpredictable memory states—making debugging and security governance nearly impossible at scale.
en.astraea.pipelineHint: Tap or hover any node to inspect deterministic guarantees
en.astraea.f1Desc: Native execution loop supporting three distinct MoA collaboration modes without hidden middleware overhead or opaque retry chains.
en.astraea.f2Desc: Human-readable, inspectable graph-based memory architecture—eliminating black-box vector state drift and enabling Git-diffable state audits.
en.astraea.f3Desc: Built-in verification layers to cross-examine intermediate reasoning, catch hallucinations, and enforce output integrity before downstream execution.
en.astraea.f4Desc: Native MCP (Model Context Protocol) bridging paired with multi-provider BYOK routing so engineering teams never face vendor lock-in.
en.systems.headline: Architecture case studies & systems R&D.
en.systems.s1Desc: Autonomous multi-agent OS built on AstraeaADK for solo-founder workflows. Features database-composed runtime roles, atomic Kanban ticket leasing to prevent race conditions, sandboxed execution, and an independent oversight agent.
en.systems.s1Note: Kept private by design to prevent automated abuse; architecture breakdown available upon request.
en.systems.s2Desc: Local desktop defense engine designed to disrupt classic deepfake and VAE-based manipulation pipelines via ONNX adjoint gradient graphs, DCT Meta-UAP perturbations, and Ed25519 cryptographic provenance seals.
en.systems.s2Note: Archived after rigorous internal red-teaming proved modern VLM/ViT editors bypass classic VAE defenses—documenting empirical limits honestly.
en.systems.s3Desc: Offline-first, bit-accurate lossless audio player (up to 24-bit/192 kHz) for Windows and Android. Powered by a custom Rust DSP core, 5-band equalizer, and automated FFT spectrum validation to reject fake transcoded FLAC files.
en.systems.s3Note: Zero-stutter cross-platform FFI architecture with deterministic FFT verification before SQLite ingestion.
en.stack.headline: Engineered for depth where it counts.
en.contact.subcopy: Open for AI Systems Engineering roles, multi-agent & database architecture consulting, and select technical collaborations.

id.hero.tagline: Merancang arsitektur AI secara native dari prinsip dasar.
id.identity.p1: Saya AI Systems Engineer asal Indonesia yang berfokus pada arsitektur multi-agent native, layanan web backend yang tangguh, serta rekayasa lapisan data di PostgreSQL, MongoDB, dan MySQL.
id.identity.p2: Kekuatan inti saya ada pada perancangan arsitektur, riset teknis mendalam, profiling performa, dan audit keamanan. Meski saya berkolaborasi dengan model AI frontier sebagai rekan diskusi riset dan akselerator implementasi, setiap keputusan arsitektur disusun dari prinsip dasar dan diaudit manual baris demi baris sebelum dirilis.
id.identity.w1Desc: Menetapkan topologi sistem, kontrak skema database, dan batas kegagalan.
id.identity.w2Desc: Membangun runtime Python/JS ramping tanpa lapisan orkestrasi kotak hitam.
id.identity.w3Desc: Review kode manual, profiling latensi, dan uji celah keamanan red-team.
id.approach.intro: Rekayasa perangkat lunak modern bukan soal siapa paling cepat mengetik boilerplate—melainkan memahami apa yang harus dibangun, mengapa desainnya kuat saat ditekan, dan di mana titik lemahnya.
id.approach.p1Desc: Framework AI yang berat sering menyembunyikan alur eksekusi di balik abstraksi rapuh. Saya membangun loop orkestrasi secara native demi kendali penuh atas state, latensi, dan efisiensi token.
id.approach.p2Desc: LLM bersifat probabilistik, sedangkan sistem produksi tidak boleh menebak-nebak. Saya memisahkan penalaran model dari validasi runtime deterministik, leasing DB atomik, dan batas keamanan ketat.
id.approach.p3Desc: Setiap sistem melewati audit kode manual baris demi baris, pengujian tekanan arsitektur, serta validasi empiris terhadap hambatan performa dan celah keamanan.
id.astraea.tagline: Mesin orkestrasi multi-agent tanpa framework yang dibangun dari nol.
id.astraea.problemBody: Framework agent yang ada sering mengunci engineer pada abstraksi kaku, loop retry yang buram, dan state memori yang tidak terprediksi—membuat debugging serta tata kelola keamanan sangat sulit pada skala produksi.
id.astraea.pipelineHint: Sentuh atau arahkan kursor ke tiap node untuk melihat jaminan deterministiknya
id.astraea.f1Desc: Loop eksekusi native yang mendukung tiga mode kolaborasi MoA berbeda tanpa overhead middleware tersembunyi.
id.astraea.f2Desc: Arsitektur memori berbasis graph yang mudah dibaca dan diaudit manusia—menghilangkan drift state vector kotak hitam.
id.astraea.f3Desc: Lapisan verifikasi bawaan untuk menguji silang penalaran, menangkap halusinasi, dan menjaga integritas output sebelum eksekusi lanjutan.
id.astraea.f4Desc: Bridging MCP (Model Context Protocol) secara native yang dipadukan dengan routing BYOK multi-provider tanpa vendor lock-in.
id.systems.headline: Studi kasus arsitektur & riset sistem.
id.systems.s1Desc: Sistem operasi multi-agent otonom di atas AstraeaADK untuk alur kerja solo-founder. Memiliki peran agent berbasis database saat runtime, leasing tiket Kanban atomik, eksekusi sandbox, dan agent pengawas independen.
id.systems.s1Note: Dijaga privat sesuai desain untuk mencegah penyalahgunaan otomatis; rincian arsitektur tersedia atas permintaan.
id.systems.s2Desc: Aplikasi desktop lokal untuk mengganggu pipeline deepfake klasik dan manipulasi VAE menggunakan graph gradien adjoin ONNX, perturbasi DCT Meta-UAP, serta segel provenans kriptografi Ed25519.
id.systems.s2Note: Diarsipkan setelah red-teaming internal membuktikan editor VLM/ViT modern melewati pertahanan VAE klasik—mendokumentasikan batas empiris secara jujur.
id.systems.s3Desc: Pemutar audio lossless offline-first bit-accurate (hingga 24-bit/192 kHz) untuk Windows dan Android. Ditenagai inti DSP Rust kustom, equalizer 5-band, dan validasi spektrum FFT otomatis penolak FLAC palsu.
id.systems.s3Note: Arsitektur FFI lintas platform tanpa stutter dengan verifikasi FFT deterministik sebelum masuk SQLite.
id.stack.headline: Mendalam pada fondasi yang paling menentukan.
id.contact.subcopy: Terbuka untuk peran AI Systems Engineer, konsultasi arsitektur multi-agent & database, serta kolaborasi teknis terpilih.
